segments.name: Same-Store
segments.description: Multifamily properties owned and not in development as of the start of 2024, earning rent from residents.
segments.evidence: Same-Store includes properties that were owned and not a development property as of January 1, 2024, and that have not been sold or identified as held for sale.

segments.name: Non Same-Store
segments.description: Multifamily properties that did not qualify as same-store as of the start of 2024, earning rent from residents.
segments.evidence: Non Same-Store includes properties that did not meet the definition of a same-store property as of January 1, 2024.

revenueModel.text: Residents pay rent under leases, generally for a term of a year or less, for apartment homes in multifamily properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Each of our multifamily properties is considered an operating segment that earns revenues through the leasing of apartment homes and incurs associated expenses.
